extraction_notes:
Angle Health proposals are branded "Angle" (purple theme) and are level-funded plans administered by Adrem Administrators LLC, with stop loss underwritten separately. Structure:
- Page 1: cover page with group name (Prepared For), Effective Date, Quote ID.
- Page 2 ("RATES"): Quote Details box (effective date, funding type, contract terms, minimum enrollment, agency, city/state/zip, subscriber/member counts), Network & Pharmacy box, Add-ons Chosen box, then a summary RATES table listing ALL plans with columns Employee Only / Employee+Spouse / Employee+Children / Employee+Family / Actuarial Value. This table often continues onto a second "RATES (CONTINUED)" page if there are many plans (in this doc, 19 total plans split across 2 pages: 14 on page2, 5 on page 3).
- Each plan then gets its OWN full detail page later in the doc, titled "PLANS" section, one plan per page, in the same order as the rate summary table. This doc had 19 distinct plan detail pages (pages 4-22) - EVERY one must be extracted individually with its full benefits table; do not shortcut based on similarity to previous plans since cost-share values, deductible-applies flags, and copay amounts differ per plan (e.g., some HDHPs are 0% coinsurance for everything (embedded vs non-embedded copay struct), others are 20%/30% coinsurance, TRAD/VALUE plans use flat copays for office visits/urgent care/Rx tiers but coinsurance for facility-based services).
- Each plan detail page layout: Plan Name (H1) + Plan ID + Quote ID at top; "In-Network Deductibles" box with 4 values (Deductible Individual, Deductible Family, OOPM Individual, OOPM Family); a Services table with columns Services | Cost Share | Deductible Applies (Yes/No) - consistently ~20 benefit rows: Primary Care (Office), Specialist (Office), Virtual Care, Preventive Care, Urgent Care, Emergency Room, Inpatient Facility, Diagnostic Tests (X-Ray), Outpatient Facility, Outpatient Professional, Speech Therapy - OP Prof., Physical/Occupational Therapy - OP Prof., Independent Laboratory, Imaging - OP Facility, All Other Covered Services, Tier 1 - Generic Rx, Tier 2 (Preferred Brand), Tier 3 (Non-Preferred Brand), Tier 4 (Specialty High-Cost), International Rx Sourcing; then "Out of Network Deductibles" box (Deductible Individual OON, OOPM Individual OON, Deductible Family OON, OOPM Family OON, Coinsurance OON, Deductible Embedded Yes/No) and a "Rates" box repeating the 4 premium tiers (no separate employee+children vs family distinction beyond these 4 tiers - there is no true single "Employee+Children" vs "Family" ambiguity, both appear as separate tiers).
- Plan naming convention: "ANG HDHP ####  ####" (deductible + OOPM in name) for HDHP plans, "ANG TRAD ### ####" for traditional copay plans, "ANG VALUE ####" for value plans. Plan IDs are alphanumeric like BENLFUT#######.
- After all plan detail pages, document includes "FUNDING ALLOCATION" pages (Claims Fund, Stoploss Premium, Administrative Fee tables per plan/tier) - these are supplemental funding breakdown, not part of the standard benefits schema, can be ignored for record_quote_data purposes unless asked.
- Then a "DETAILS" page with plan information/eligibility/terms boilerplate, and a "CENSUS QUOTED IN PROPOSAL" section listing every covered member (not needed for plan extraction).
- Marketing/infographic pages (Familiar and Easy, Cost of Ownership) at the end are not relevant to benefits extraction.
- IMPORTANT: this document had 19 plans total. Every single one needs its own full ~20-row benefits object plus deductible/OOPM/OON/rates figures pulled from its dedicated detail page - do not truncate or copy benefits from an earlier similar-named plan since cost-share percentages and copay dollar amounts vary meaningfully between plans (e.g. HDHP 5000/5000 is 0% coinsurance across the board while HDHP 4000/7000 is 20% coinsurance across the board despite similar deductible figures).
